archetypes.name: dyn-ship-rebase
archetypes.rationale: Pre-fix rebase alters Step 8+ autonomous repair routing and conflict handoff state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new ship pre-fix rebase entrypoint and Step 8+ docs. Focus on whether ci-fix and reship paths rebase exactly once before repairs, skip the phase14 continuation, and preserve conflict metadata for the existing resolution flow. Check machine stdout and handoff env keys for deterministic routing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
